fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten into the Marian equivalent of a standard Inner Sphere platoon. Foot triplus contubernia form the primary garrison infantry of the Hegemony, holding defensive lines and providing the manpower that auxiliary legions depend on for territorial control. Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
